column3: The strongest fighter in the universe was looking for a worthy opponent.
Show yourself! I will defeat anyone!
Somehow, he ended up in a kitchen.
Oh, hi! Are you here for the dishes?
Dishes? I am Kai! I have defeated a thousand warriors!
Cool! I have defeated a thousand frying pans.
Then teach me your training, little sponge.
The cup exploded. Then the bowls. Then the window.
This is the hardest training I have ever done.
Scrubby jumped into the sink and soaked up every single drop.
Kai has washed the dishes every day since. He is still not allowed to touch the cups.
